content: Nkpatsiá Há Bulu
Kristo lówun ɩwɩɔsɩn. Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩda ɩwɩsʋ mlɩ ɛ́, amlɩpʋ mʋ ɔkpa ámʋ alɩ kɛ́n. Tsúfɛ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ owun ɩwɩɔsɩn lalɛ́ mʋ ɩwɩ lɛ́ lakpantɔ.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔmátrá ha ɔwɔ́lɩ laláhɛ igyi mʋsʋ. Mboún ɔhá Bulu apɛ́bwɛ itsia mʋ klʋntɔ mʋ nkpa ánɩ́ ɩlasí ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ fɛ́ɛ́.

Asa mlɩlébemlí Akristofɔ á, mlɩléyintá brɛ́ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ tsíá bwɛ́ tɔ́á ahá ánɩ́ bʋmeyín Bulu bʋtekle bwɛ. Mʋ́ aná gyí; atsɩ mʋ́a ayin asʋ́nwa, ntábʋ, pléikpada mʋ́a ntakpan onúkpa yɔ pʋ́ ɩkpɩtswɛ́ɛ ánɩ́ ígyi mlɩ akisítɔ.
Itobwíé ɔmátɔ́fɔ ámʋ ɔnɔ́ ánɩ́ séi mlɩtráa mlɩmɛ́dɛ́srɩ́ buo amʋ́ yɔ́bwɛ lalahɛ. Mʋ́ sʋ́ bʋtesíá mlɩ nɩ́.
Támɛ bɛ́lɛ amʋ́ bwɛhɛ́ fɛ́ɛ́ ɔnɔ́ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́. Mʋ ɔbá begyi akɩankpapʋ pʋ́ awupʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ asʋ́n nɩ́.

Mʋ́ sʋ́ bɛyɛ́da Bulu asʋ́n wankláán ámʋ ɔkan há awupʋ́ nɩ́. Amʋ́ lowu ámʋ igyi ɩsʋá Bulu labɩ́tɩ́ amʋ́ ɔyʋlʋ́ʋ, fɛ́ alɩá ɔtɛbɩ́tɩ́ ɔhagyíɔha ɩsʋ. Bɛyɛ́da Bulu asʋ́n ámʋ ɔkan há amʋ́, mɛ́nɩ amʋ́ ɔkláa obénya nkpa fɛ́ alɩá Bulu bʋ nkpa.
Bulu Atokiehɛ́ Kɩtá Wankláán
Tógyítɔ́ ɔnɔ́mɔ lafʋn ta. Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩkɩta ɩwɩ, amlɩha mlɩ agywɩɩntɔ ɩdɩ, mɛ́nɩ mlɛ́talɩ́ bɔ́ mpáɩ.
Mʋ́á ɩdʋn mʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ gyí, mlɩdwɛ aba tsu mlɩ klʋntɔ. Tsúfɛ́ ɔdwɛ ánfɩ odu ɔbɛ́ha mlɛ́talɩ́ sí ahá lakpan kíé amʋ́ nɩ́.
Mlɩpʋ ansigyí hɔ mlɩ aba Akristofɔ afɔɔ́, mlɩmáblɩ́ mlɩaa ɩlakpɔn mlɩ.
Bulu lakíé ɔhagyíɔha atɔ́ ɔtsan-ɔtsan. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔhagyíɔha ɔkɩ́ta mʋ klɛtɔ wankláán, amlɩpʋkpa aba.

Nɩ́ ɔkʋ klɛ́ gyí Bulu asʋ́nblɩ́ á, ɔblɩ́ asʋ́n ánɩ́ itsú Bulu wá. Nɩ́ ɔkʋ klɛ́ gyí ahá súm á, ɔpʋ́ʋ ɔwʋnlɩ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu lahá mʋ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ súm mʋ aba. Ɩ́nɩ ɔbɛ́ha ahá bɛ́kanfʋ́ Bulu tsʋn Yesu Kristosʋ tógyítɔ́tɔ́. Numnyam mʋ́a túmi igyi Bulu klɛ́ brɛ́ fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́. Amen.
Akristofɔ Ipianwúun
Mɩ́ apíó adwɛpʋ́, mlɩmáha asʋn wunhɛ kpɔnkpɔɔnkpɔntɩ ánfɩ bʋdɛpʋsɔ mlɩ kɩ anfɩ ibwie mlɩ ɔnɔ́. Mlɩmákɩ mʋ́ ánɩ́ asʋn pɔpwɛ dɛ́ mlɩ tʋ.
Mlɩha ansɩ́ mboún igyi mlɩ ánɩ́ mlɩdɛ́ Kristo asʋn wunhɛ amʋ kʋ wúun, mɛ́nɩ ansɩ́ bɛtrá hɩɛ gyí mlɩ ɛkɛ ámʋ́ʋ́ mʋ numnyam bɛ́lɩn ɔwan ámʋ.
Nɩ́ ahá bʋdɛ mlɩ sia Kristo búo sʋ á, idesuná ánɩ́ nwun lawá olú. Bulu Numnyam Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋ bʋ mlɩtɔ.
Mlɩtɔ ɔkʋkʋ ɔmáwun asʋ́n ahámɔ, ntɛ́ɛ owi, ntɛ́ɛ lakpanbwɛ, ntɛ́ɛ okéngyéwa sʋ.
Támɛ nɩ́ mlɩgyí Akristofɔ sʋ mlɩdɛ́ asʋ́n wúun a, ɩmáwa mlɩ pɛ́lɩ. Mboún mlɩkanfʋ Bulu ánɩ́ Kristo ɩdá dɩn mlɩsʋ.

Tsúfɛ́ brɛ́ lafʋn ánɩ́ Bulu obégyi ɔhagyíɔha asʋ́n. Obégyankpá gyi mʋ onutó ahá asʋ́n. Nɩ́ Bulu obéfi mʋ́ asɩ tsú anɩsʋ á, mʋ́mʋ́ nkálɩ ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋmɔhɔ mʋ asʋn wankláán ámʋsʋ gyi amʋ klɛ́ bɔ́bwɛ? Ɩbɛ́hɩɛ wá ifú.
Bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋ́ntɔ́ bɛɛ,

content.text: “Nɩ́ ɩbɔ́wa ɔnlɩn asa Bulu ɔbɔ́hɔ yilé abwɛpʋ́ nkpa á,
mʋ́mʋ́ nkálɩ ibégyi ha lakpan abwɛpʋ́ pʋ́ ahá ánɩ́ bʋtamabú Bulu ɛ́? Iméetepí wá alɛ́ há amʋ́.”

content: Mʋ́ sʋ ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ igyi Bulu apɛ́ ánɩ́ bʋwúun asʋ́n ámʋ bʋpʋ́ʋ amʋ́ ɩwɩ fɛ́ɛ́ wa amʋ́ Ɔlɛpʋ́ ámʋ ɩbɩtɔ, abʋkɩta yilébwɛtɔ kínkíínkín. Otegyi mʋ asʋ́nsʋ́ brégyíbrɛ́.
